name: UF-fast-seed-hunt
note: Scout compositions fast: LCM mode x8. Lock the seed you like, then render at quality. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/fast-seed-hunt.  (sample: seed 1070)

form.subject: a (haunted graveyard:1.3), (crooked iron gate:1.2), gnarled dead trees, tombstones
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (haunted graveyard:1.3), (crooked iron gate:1.2), gnarled dead trees, tombstones, ega_art, EGA 16-color pixel art, scene background, adventure game, 1980s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora ega-art-v2.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette EGA --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 4 --pixel-angles 1.5 --fast --seed 1070
